text:
Lena: Quick micro-snapshot for quarterly milestones across eng+product. TL;DR — Model-routing and batch-caching shipped; Dedicated autoscale slipped; Quant validation is a risk. Owners and short next steps below.

Jordan: Model-routing v2.1 deployed to us-west yesterday 22:12 UTC — no perf regressions in smoke. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/model-routing/flows :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy succeeded — model-routing v2.1 — build #4521 — https://ci.redwood/build/4521

Priya: Batch-caching deploy caused 1hr tail latency spike at ~02:10 UTC. Rolled back to canary. Repro steps attached in PR comments.

Marco: Dedicated autoscale blocked by NVLink firmware mismatch on 4 GPU hosts. HW vendor engaged; tentative ETA Tue EOD. Tracked in infra/4567.

Sam: Owners please confirm: Marco -> Dedicated autoscale; Jordan -> model-routing followups; Priya+Marco -> batch-caching stabilization. Reply with ✅ when ok.

Jordan: ✅ I'll add the canary gate and a post-deploy perf check in the PR. PR: https://git.redwood/r/model-routing/pull/789

Marco: ✅ Filed infra ticket infra/4567 and vendor ping sent. Also prepping fallback plan to force smaller batch sizes if firmware fix delayed.

Priya: Working on perf patch; will open hotfix PR today and add alert threshold (p99 > 250ms).

Lena: Thanks — two quick asks: (1) please add expected rollback criteria to each PR, (2) product needs ETA on feature-wide availability for customer comms. Short answers ok.

Marco: ETA for Dedicated autoscale GA now sliding to next sprint if firmware takes until Tue. I'll update infra/4567 with expected GA dates.

Jordan: Model-routing GA still on track for next week once canary passes one more day. I'll post a short runbook for support.

Sam: For comms, I'll hold an async note for customers with current status + expected GAs once owners confirm.

Lena: Great — if anyone hits new unblocks, ping here. Otherwise we'll roll this into the quarterly exec update tomorrow. :rocket:
